Z_00032_1.desc: A flat stamped steel strap bracket bent into a shallow Z: two parallel mounting flanges offset by a central web, with a pressed stiffening rib running across the web. One flange carries a row of three round through holes, the other has a round hole plus an elongated adjustment slot; all transitions are filleted and the strap keeps a constant thin rectangular section.

Z_00032_0.desc: A uniform-thickness flat metal strap formed into an L-shaped corner brace: a short top leg and a longer drop leg joined by a large outer radius, with an integral diagonal tie between the legs that frames a triangular lightening window. The strip has a narrow rectangular cross-section, all outer corners are rounded with small fillets, and there are several small through holes at the free ends of both legs and along the vertical leg, plus a pair of slightly larger holes clustered at the inner corner.

Z_00109_0.desc: Open-ended monolithic thick-walled regular-hex tube with a coaxial hexagonal through-bore and chamfered end rims. One flat carries a centered axial column of identical hexagonal through-pockets, while adjacent flats mix long closed-end slots, raised guide rails, small end notches, dense triangular dimples, edge ribs, and short rectangular or hexagonal locating bosses; arrises are lightly filleted.

Z_00109_1.desc: Same family as a smoother hexagonal spacer sleeve: three alternate flats are plain and three each contain one full-length keyway around the same coaxial hex bore. A circumferential retaining groove, chamfered lead-in, and four mid-height radial threaded holes replace the long pocket column.

Z_00114_1.desc: A heavier machined clamp collar made from thick rectangular-section ring stock, split once with two blocky lug pads facing across the gap; each pad holds a pair of through holes for two pinch bolts, with a small relief slot at the split, a light locating dowel between the pads, chamfered bore edges, and a shallow counterbore on the outer face.

Z_00051_0.desc: A constant-width thin sheet strip folded along several parallel transverse creases into an open lightning-bolt (Z) profile: four flat rectangular panels linked edge-to-edge by sharp alternating bends and meeting in pointed outer corners. Uniform wall throughout with no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or fillets—only planar flanges and bend edges.

Z_00051_2.desc: A narrow sheet-metal channel clip folded into a three-sided C profile with two unequal side flanges and a small closing tab. A row of three pierced holes runs along the back, one flange carries an embossed dimple and a lanced retention tab, and the open end is hemmed.

Z_00051_1.desc: A bent sheet-metal mounting bracket formed from one blank into a flat base flange, an upright web, and a short return lip. The base carries two round holes, the web has one slotted hole plus a single pressed stiffening rib, and the bend corners are filleted.

Z_00048_0.desc: A short open cylindrical saddle shell: one thick curved wall wrapping a little more than half of a circle, with a round through-bore along the axis concentric with the outer cylindrical face and a constant wall between them. The crown is cut away to leave a wide upward opening bounded by two straight longitudinal lips, both axial ends are plain square faces, and the part is symmetric about the vertical center plane with no ribs, bosses, or fastener holes.

Z_00048_1.desc: A split cradle built as two mating half shells, a lower seat and an upper strap, each with two side ears carrying through bolt holes so the round bore closes into a complete ring. The outer back of the lower half has one transverse stiffening rib and generous fillets where the ears blend into the shell.

Z_00041_1.desc: A uniform-thickness right-triangular gusset plate bounded by two perpendicular legs and a diagonal outer edge. The inner corner is relieved by a concave quarter-round cutout, three clearance holes are patterned along the two legs, and the outer vertices are rounded rather than pointed.

Z_00041_2.desc: A thin flat bracket plate symmetric about its longitudinal centerline, with matching concave semicircular notches in both side edges that form a narrow waist. A central row of three round holes passes through the waist, both ends are blunt rectangular tabs, and each external corner carries a small fillet.

Z_00041_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate cut to a tapered triangular outline that ends in a sharp nose on one side. The wide end is opened by a single large concave semicircular notch, leaving short rectangular ears above and below it; the remaining perimeter is one straight edge and one diagonal edge, with no holes, ribs, bends, or bosses.

Z_00023_1.desc: Two-lobe bar-style spinner plate of uniform thickness: a central finger-bearing hub with one large ring boss at each opposite end, giving a smooth dumbbell outline. Replace the scalloped rims with fine straight knurling around the two end rings, add shallow counterbores on both faces of each large bore, and put one small radial set-screw hole into each ring to retain the inserted bearings.

Z_00023_2.desc: Four-arm star spinner plate: central through-bored hub with four equal bearing bosses on the same bolt circle at ninety-degree spacing, connected by a pierced web that leaves four curved lightening windows. Mix features by giving two opposite bosses plain smooth rims and the other two scalloped rims, counterbore every bearing seat from one face only, and thread one extra small radial hole in a single boss for an adjustable balance weight.

Z_00023_0.desc: Thin uniform-thickness plate with a three-lobe clover silhouette: a small central through-bored hub joined by three curved waisted arms to three identical outer ring bosses spaced equally around the center. Each outer boss has one large through bore and a scalloped, gear-like rim made of many small equal-radius scallops, with concave outer notches between lobes and softly filleted edges throughout.

Z_00060_1.part_family: round slotted drain strainer with perforated basket
Z_00060_1.desc: Flat one-piece circular drain grate with a plain outer bezel and a face pierced by several concentric annular slots separated by matching concentric ribs. A solid round center pad carries a small lift tab, while the underside uses short radial reinforcing ribs and a flexible snap ridge on the outer diameter in place of a separate basket.

Z_00019_2.part_family: thin-panel workstation desk with pigeonhole hutch
Z_00019_2.desc: A compact wall-hung sorting cabinet in the same family, with no legs: a shallow panel carcass divided into many columns of small cubbies with removable dividers and front label holders. A fold-down writing flap on side stays covers the lower cubbies when closed, and the rear panel carries mounting cleats with keyhole slots plus a row of ventilation slots near the top.

Z_00019_0.part_family: thin-panel workstation desk with pigeonhole hutch
Z_00019_0.desc: An L-shaped workstation built from thin rectangular panels: a left pedestal frames two stacked drawer openings within a side modesty panel, joined by a flat desktop and a lower shelf to a tall right hutch panel. The hutch carries a repeated grid of small square pigeonhole cubbies set above a larger rectangular recess and an open knee bay, with edge-joined panels, small corner radii, and dense rows of evenly spaced small holes along the panel edges.

Z_00036_0.desc: A thin straight rail is built as one tall narrow wall with a continuous top flange and a lower serrated edge, forming a shallow longitudinal channel. Along the channel are repeated short ribs and twenty-eight small round-nosed teeth grouped between transverse tabs; both ends carry latch feet, one end has a single through-hole, and the teeth and feet are softly filleted.

Z_00036_2.desc: A longer guide variant uses an open C-section with one mid-span latch and two fixed end hooks; the floor has elongated slots and a single alignment aperture near one hook. Interior stiffening ribs run in long-and-short bays, and the mounting feet are gusseted rather than plain tabs.

Z_00036_1.desc: A shorter member of the family is a closed-back socket rail: two parallel side walls are tied by end bridges and a central keying web, with paired blind cavities and spring tongues in the channel. It uses four board-lock posts and an offset polarizing boss, with coarser grouped ribs and larger end radii.

Z_00061_0.desc: A one-piece shallow rectangular open frame (four-sided ring) with a large centered rectangular window. A constant ornate molding cross-section of many fine ribs, steps and grooves runs continuously around all four sides and meets in square corners. The outer edge carries a scalloped ogee contour while the inner edge is a clean reveal; small integral rectangular tabs sit at the lower inner edge and two small fillets ease the top inner corners.

Z_00061_2.desc: A rectangular two-light variant in which the same decorative ribbed molding forms the outer frame while an integral center mullion splits the opening into two side-by-side windows. Corners are softly radiused instead of scalloped, the back carries snap-fit clip hooks around each opening for a separate retention strip, and small drain notches are cut at the bottom of each light.

Z_00061_1.desc: A closed elliptical ring of the same ribbed molded profile, with the decorative section following the curve and small crest bosses at the ends of the long axis. The back has a continuous retaining rabbet plus several equally spaced keyhole mounting slots, and the inner lip is a smooth rounded bead rather than a sharp rectangular reveal.

Z_00098_0.desc: Single flat strip of uniform width and gauge, press-brake folded along several crease lines that run straight across the band. A long central leg is joined through two angled bends to an inclined top tab, while the lower end is folded out into a short foot whose tip is turned down as a small end flange; no holes, slots, ribs or bosses, with inside bend radii and crisp outside corners.

Z_00038_2.desc: A narrow bent sheet-metal clip formed by three parallel folds into a U-shaped channel with two legs and a closed back. Both legs share a pair of matching circular pin holes, one leg is extended and relieved by a single rectangular slot, and the back is doubled over with a flattened hem seam.

Z_00038_1.desc: A bent sheet-metal mounting bracket with a rectangular base flange and one upright flange folded at a right angle along a single bend. The upright carries two slotted mounting holes and one round clearance hole, with a small triangular gusset folded between the flanges and a hemmed outer edge for stiffness.

Z_00038_0.desc: A bent sheet-metal bracket of uniform thickness folded along straight bend lines into an open angular channel of intersecting flat flanges. One long edge carries a single deep V-shaped notch near an end, while the opposite end is cut on a taper down to a pointed tip. All walls are planar with sharp outside corners, small inside bend radii, and no holes, slots, ribs, or bosses.

Z_00093_2.desc: Adjustable two-eye link with matching round end rings tied by an edge-ribbed strap. One ring is a plain bearing seat with circlip grooves, the other is a closed elongated eye for pin travel; two oval web openings and a single external bead provide stiffness instead of a radial small-hole pattern.

Z_00093_0.desc: Thin flat link with two dissimilar annular eye bosses joined by a narrow waist; the larger boss has a plain central bore ringed by several small through holes, while the smaller boss has its own bore with a compact radial hole pattern and shallow counterbored faces. The web carries an axial lightening slot, stepped pad heights, edge rounds and generous fillets into both rings.

Z_00093_1.desc: Triangular three-boss bell-crank plate in the same family: one large keyed pivot eye and two smaller clevis eyes are raised rings on a common thin web. A triangular lightening opening and two short gusset ribs stiffen the spans; every junction is filleted and one eye adds a threaded counterbore plus dowel holes.

Z_00034_2.desc: Six-pad ring spacer plate with circular lobes around an open center; alternating pads carry counterbored holes, two opposed pads include radial slots, and short gusset-like thickenings appear only in the connecting webs.

Z_00034_1.desc: Three-lobe flat link plate in a triangular layout, with round pads joined by concave waist sections; one pad uses a slotted mounting hole, the center has a plain clearance hole, and the outline is fully filleted for laser-cut or stamped production.

Z_00034_0.desc: Uniform-thickness cloverleaf plate made from four equal round lobes in a two-by-two cluster; the paired lobes are tangent while the left and right groups are tied by narrow waisted webs. It has one small across-flats through feature at a central pad, an open rectangular edge relief on the opposite side, generous perimeter blend radii, and no raised ribs beyond the plate thickness.

Z_00052_0.desc: A single constant-thickness metal strip is straight in plan and formed across its narrow width as a shallow circular-arch shell for the full length. It has plain cut ends, two long side edges, and no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or patterned features; only small edge breaks are implied.

Z_00052_1.desc: A same-family spring leaf uses a constant-gauge arched shell but adds two round mounting holes near one end, one central longitudinal slot, and a short hooked tab bent from the opposite tip. The cross-section stays a simple open curve with smooth tangent transitions into the tab.

Z_00009_1.desc: Flat annular distribution plate with a wide clamping flange carrying a few counterbored mounting holes and a sealing O-ring groove, plus one large central inlet bore feeding radial spoke passages that open into staggered hole rows. The face uses a single hole size grouped in wedge sectors separated by solid webs, and the back has small integral standoff bosses.

Z_00009_0.desc: One-piece turned disc with a plain cylindrical outer rim and a shallow raised central land forming a slightly dished, stepped face. The land is densely perforated by small through-holes arranged as several concentric equally spaced rings around a central patterned array of three lettered hole types; the back is essentially flat with a small annular step and there are no ribs, bosses or threads.

Z_00056_1.part_family: thin flat slat with obliquely cut ends
Z_00056_1.desc: A narrow flat strap of the same slat family but with square-cut ends; one end carries two spaced through holes for fasteners while the opposite end has one centred oblong adjustment slot, and all outer edges receive a small uniform radius rather than a sharp shear edge.

Z_00056_2.part_family: thin flat slat with obliquely cut ends
Z_00056_2.desc: A similar thin leaf whose thickness is stepped: a short thicker pad at one end blends through a shallow taper into the slender blade, the pad is pierced by a single countersunk hole, a low pressed rib runs lengthwise along the blade centreline, and the far tip is clipped at one oblique angle only.

Z_00056_0.part_family: thin flat slat with obliquely cut ends
Z_00056_0.desc: A single monolithic flat strip of constant thin rectangular cross-section, much longer than it is wide, with plain parallel faces and no holes, slots, ribs or bosses; both short ends are sheared on the same matching skew angle so the two long edges finish at different stations, leaving sharp cut faces with only a light edge break.

Z_00104_1.desc: Stamped and bent flat-strip tool built from a single solid spring tang that widens into a serrated thumb tab pierced by three holes. Past the tab the strip is folded in two offset bends to raise a blunt twin-prong fork tip, with full edge radii and no terminal hook.

Z_00104_0.desc: One elongated thin metal strip: a broad cross-hatched grip end carries two through holes, then the strip necks down and splits lengthwise into two parallel edge rails. The rails converge and roll into a small rounded J-hook tip with a transverse end groove; all edges use generous fillets and the wall stays uniformly thin.

Z_00057_2.desc: Shallow hat-section stiffener made from one strip with two parallel longitudinal folds and short hems on the outer edges; it has three spaced pierced slots in the web, one drawn dimple near mid-length, an open cut end, and a closed folded tab at the opposite end.

Z_00057_0.desc: Single folded metal strip forming a long straight face panel with very narrow turned-over longitudinal edge flanges; both short ends are bent upward into ear-like tabs, with small bend radii, visible fold/hem lines, and no through-holes or bosses.

Z_00057_1.desc: Open right-angle sheet-metal bracket with unequal legs: the taller leg carries two round mounting holes while the base leg has one obround slot; one end is stiffened by a small folded triangular gusset and the other end is plain sheared.

Z_00112_0.part_family: slender spindle with a fine-tooth gear wheel
Z_00112_0.desc: A rotationally symmetric shaft part: one long plain cylindrical spindle carries a thin toothed disc at one end, with a short larger-diameter collar shouldering the disc to the spindle. The disc has a single row of many fine teeth around its outer rim, a central through-bore with a shallow faced recess on one side, and a small radius at the bore edge; the tooth roots and hub transitions are filleted, and the spindle end opposite the wheel is plain.

Z_00112_1.part_family: slender spindle with a fine-tooth gear wheel
Z_00112_1.desc: A compact stepped pinion shaft with the toothed wheel set near mid-length rather than at the tip, leaving a short pilot journal on one side and a longer bearing journal on the other. The wheel has fewer, coarser rim teeth and a keyed central bore, while the longer journal carries one transverse cross-hole and a single narrow retaining groove; all diameter changes are shouldered with small fillets.

Z_00115_1.part_family: small toothed transmission elements - annular ring gears, pinions and straight racks
Z_00115_1.desc: Straight metric gear rack: a constant-thickness rectangular steel bar with teeth cut along one long edge only, a solid plain back rail for stiffness, a row of mounting through-holes plus one longitudinal keyway slot on the untoothed face, end chamfers, and induction-hardened flanks with ground root fillets.
